segments.english: Shelah lived thirty years, and he fathered Eber.
segments.literal: and-Shelah lived thirty year and-fathered [object-marker] Eber

tokens.note: perfect, placed after the subject: the life-span is stated first
singular שָׁנָה after a number above ten, as usual
wayyiqtol of the Hifil, 'caused to be born', the usual verb for a father begetting

phrases.literal: 'and-Shelah lived thirty year'; the waw is a simple connective and is left out of the English at the start of the entry
the object marker has no English counterpart

grammar: The verse is built on a fixed pattern: subject, חַי, number of years, then וַיּוֹלֶד and the son. The subject comes first, so חַי is a plain perfect.
The etnaḥta on שָׁנָה divides the verse between the years lived and the begetting.
וַיּוֹלֶד is a Hifil wayyiqtol of ילד, 'he fathered'.
segments.note: Shelah's age at the birth of Eber is stated; the verse does not say Eber was his firstborn.

commentary.summary: Onkelos renders the verse closely: וְשֶׁלַח חֲיָא תְּלָתִין שְׁנִין וְאוֹלִיד יָת עֵבֶר, with the same numbers and the same sequence.

segments.english: Shelah lived four hundred and three years after fathering Eber, and he fathered sons and daughters.
segments.literal: and-lived Shelah after fathering-him [object-marker] Eber three years and-four hundreds year and-fathered sons and-daughters

tokens.note: wayyiqtol of חיה; the maqqef joins it to the subject
infinitive construct with 3rd masculine singular suffix: 'his fathering', the suffix is the subject

phrases.literal: 'after his-fathering'; the infinitive with suffix is rendered as a gerund
the object marker has no English counterpart
'three years and-four hundreds year': the units come first, the hundreds after, with the waw before the hundreds

phrases.english: and he fathered sons and daughters

grammar: The number is given as 'three years and four hundreds year'; the smaller number precedes, and מֵאוֹת, the plural of מֵאָה, 'hundreds', is followed by singular שָׁנָה.
אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ is a preposition with an infinitive construct and a suffix: 'after his fathering'.
שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים: feminine שָׁלֹשׁ with feminine plural שָׁנִים.
The zaqef qaton on עֵבֶר and on שָׁנִים and the etnaḥta on שָׁנָה divide the verse into the time after the birth and the other children.
segments.note: The spelling וַֽיְחִי with gaʿya (meteg) is as in the pack; the sense is plain.

commentary.summary: Onkelos: וַחֲיָא שֶׁלַח בָּתַר דְּאוֹלִיד יָת עֵבֶר אַרְבַּע מְאָה וּתְלָת שְׁנִין, the same total of four hundred and three years after the birth.

apparatus: The pack gives a paragraph mark (ס) after this verse.

segments.english: Eber lived thirty-four years, and he fathered Peleg.
segments.literal: and-lived Eber four and-thirty year and-fathered [object-marker] Peleg

phrases.literal: the object marker has no English counterpart

grammar: The number is given as 'four and thirty', the units first; the pack lists אַרְבַּע as feminine, with שָׁנָה.
The zaqef gadol on עֵבֶר separates the subject from the figures.
The etnaḥta on שָׁנָה divides the verse before וַיּוֹלֶד.
segments.note: The pack's parse lists שָׁנָה as singular after the number, as usual with numbers above ten.

commentary.summary: Onkelos: וַחֲיָא עֵבֶר תְּלָתִין וְאַרְבַּע שְׁנִין וְאוֹלִיד יָת פָּלֶג, the same figures, tens before units in Aramaic.

segments.english: Eber lived four hundred and thirty years after fathering Peleg, and he fathered sons and daughters.
segments.literal: and-lived Eber after fathering-him [object-marker] Peleg thirty year and-four hundreds year and-fathered sons and-daughters

tokens.note: infinitive construct with 3rd masculine singular suffix

phrases.literal: the object marker has no English counterpart

phrases.english: and he fathered sons and daughters

grammar: The sum is split in two: 'thirty years' and 'four hundred years', each with its own שָׁנָה; the English joins them as 'four hundred and thirty'.
אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת־פֶּלֶג is 'after his fathering Peleg'.
The revia on עֵבֶר and pashta on אַחֲרֵי mark the subject and the preposition, and the zaqef qaton on פֶּלֶג closes the clause.
segments.note: The total is given in two parts; the English adds them.

commentary.summary: Onkelos: וַחֲיָא עֵבֶר בָּתַר דְּאוֹלִיד יָת פֶּלֶג אַרְבַּע מְאָה וּתְלָתִין שְׁנִין, giving the total as one sum of four hundred and thirty.

apparatus: The pack gives a paragraph mark (ס) after this verse.
